functions.purpose: Looks up a level-category extra-reward config entry from a score/points value. Computes a bucket index = (param_1 / 100000) then subtracts the config's minId base at mgr+0x24; bounds-checks against the flat vector, and if the slot is non-null delegates to FUN_11826c90(param_1) to build the reward.
formulas: bucketIndex = param_1 / 100000 - *(mgr+0x24)   (0x100000-style divisor is decimal 100000, i.e. score->bucket)
costs: score bucket width = 100000 points per category tier
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative (server maps accumulated score/points to a reward tier via config; must use same 100000 divisor and minId base)

Builds, for a league object (param_1), the sorted list of matching round-schedule entries and reward-schedule entries. Iterates CLeagueRoundSchedule table; keeps entries whose entry+0x14 (owner/leagueType) equals the league's virtual-call result (**(*param_1+0x18))(); inserts into a set keyed by entry+0x18 (round order) via a balanced tree (local_34/puStack_30 = red-black-like node walk comparing at offset 4). Collected round ptrs are pushed to vector param_1[0x2c..0x2e], then binary-insertion-sorted (FUN_118447c0 heap/introsort with FUN_11847310 comparator; threshold 0x10/0x40 elements). Then iterates CLeagueRewardSchedule table; keeps entries where entry+0x14 == param_1[5] (league type) AND FUN_118b2170(param_1[6]) passes; pushes to vector param_1[0x2f..0x31] and sorts with FUN_118472f0 comparator (skipped when param_1[5]==4).
formulas: reward kept if entry+0x14 == param_1[5] (leagueType) AND FUN_118b2170(param_1[6]) != 0
sort depth = log2(count) via loop halving (iVar5>>=1); introsort threshold count<0x11 -> insertion sort, else heap-partition first 0x40
league type 4 is special-cased (reward list not sorted/built): if (param_1[5] != 4) ...
round vector at param_1[0x2c](begin)/[0x2d](end)/[0x2e](cap); reward vector at [0x2f]/[0x30]/[0x31]; league type at [5], sub-key at [6]
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative (server determines which reward/round schedules apply to a league instance; ordering drives reward distribution)
functions.notes: FUN_118b2170 = time/window predicate; FUN_11847310/118472f0 = sort comparators; FUN_10a1a390/3c0 = string/container init. param_1 is a CLeague* whose vtable+0x18 returns its group id.

functions.purpose: Validates that all rule-config references on an equipment-generation descriptor exist. Reads five keys off param_1 and confirms each referenced rule table has the entry (or the key is <=0 meaning unused): +0x24 CEquipRandBaseItemRuleInfo, +0x28 CWeaponWakeUpRandRuleInfo, +0x2c CEquipEnforceRuleInfo, +0x34 (via FUN_11851550), +0x30 (via FUN_118514b0 enchase). Returns early if a required (>0) key resolves to null.
formulas: for each rule table: paged-map lookup idx=key-minId(+0x30), page=*(*(+0x20)+(idx/pageSize)*4), val=*(page+(idx%pageSize)*4); pageSize=*(+0x28), cap=*(+0x24)
field map: param_1+0x24=RandBaseItemRuleId, +0x28=WeaponWakeUpRandRuleId, +0x2c=EnforceRuleId, +0x30=EnchaseRuleId, +0x34=key checked via FUN_11851550
functions.serverRelevance: validation (integrity check of an equip template's rule references; server should reject items referencing missing rules)

functions.purpose: Three-level lookup in CPlayerLvAppraisalRewardInfo (player-level appraisal reward). Paged-map by param_1 (level), then walks a linked list at record+0x14 matching node[2]==param_2 (a sub-key/type), then walks that node's sub-list (node[3]..) returning the first entry whose entry[2] >= param_3 (threshold); returns entry+3.
formulas: record = paged-map(param_1): idx=param_1-minId(+0x30), page=*(*(+0x20)+(idx/pageSize)*4), record=*(page+(idx%pageSize)*4), pageSize=*(+0x28)
list1 at record+0x14: match node where node[2]==param_2 (intrusive list, next=*node)
list2 at node[3]: return (entry+3) for first entry with entry[2] >= param_3
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative (server selects appraisal reward by player level + type + threshold)

functions.purpose: Paged id-map accessor returning the CPlayerLvAppraisalRewardInfo record for a player level key param_1.
Flat-vector accessor into CLeagueRewardInfo table.

Iterates all CLegendUpgrade config entries (legendary weapon upgrade via pearls). For each entry it walks its sub-entry list (record+0x1c..+0x20, stride 0xb0), calling FUN_117e4e60 and touching CLegendPearlItemInfo; each sub-entry has an inner item list (sub+4..+8, stride 8) iterated against CItemBaseInfo. Warms/validates the pearl and item-base references used by legend upgrades.
formulas: outer records: flat vector at CLegendUpgrade mgr +0x14/+0x18
sub-entry list per record: begin=*(rec+0x1c), end=*(rec+0x20), stride 0xb0
inner item list per sub-entry: count = (*(sub+8)-*(sub+4))>>3 (stride 8)
functions.notes: FUN_117e4e60 out-of-chunk; likely per-entry pearl resolve.

functions.purpose: XML/config reader that parses a monster-wave/spawn-layer record into a struct. Uses the standard field-read pattern (attr-name intern + vtable getters +0x10 has, +0x20 int, +0x24/+0x28 string). Notably includes bound-gold and unbind-gold reward fields and a drop item group.
formulas: field->offset: layer=+0x10, modelGroupID=+0x18, time=+0x1c, delayStartTime=+0x20, isTriggerStart(bool)=+0x24, bindGlod=+0x28, unBingGold=+0x2c, addPlayerBuffID(u"IsHaveReward"-adjacent DAT_11d6f09c)=+0x30, dropItemGroupID=+0x34, addBossBuffID=+0x38, IsHaveReward=+0x3c(?), ResouceID=+0x40, +0x44, MonsterID=+0x48, MonsterNum=+0x4c
name field stored via CPet::SetName (string setter reused)
costs: bindGlod (bound gold reward for clearing the wave) -> struct+0x28
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative (server-side spawn config: gold/item rewards and monster counts the server must grant and validate)
functions.notes: 'bindGlod'/'unBingGold' are the game's spellings for bound vs unbound gold. Field offsets past 0x30 inferred from write order; IsHaveReward/ResouceID exact offsets approximate.

functions.purpose: XML reader for an activity/level reward-multiplier config. Parses per-activity-per-level scaling coefficients applied to EXP, gold, and drop rewards. Central economy tuning table for events/activities.
formulas: ActivityId=+0x10, LevelId=+0x14, LevelType=+0x18, ExpCoefficient=+0x1c, BoundGoldCoefficient=+0x20, GoldCoefficient=+0x24, RegularRewardCoefficient=+0x28, RandomRewardCoefficient=+0x2c, MonsterBasicMaterialCoefficient=+0x30, MonsterPartBrokenCoefficient=+0x34, CaptureMaterialCoefficient=+0x38
coefficients read via getter vtable+0x20 (stored as 4-byte; semantically float multipliers applied to base reward)
costs: ExpCoefficient: multiplier on EXP gained in this activity/level
BoundGoldCoefficient / GoldCoefficient: multipliers on bound vs unbound gold rewards
RegularRewardCoefficient / RandomRewardCoefficient: multipliers on fixed vs random drop rewards
MonsterBasicMaterialCoefficient / MonsterPartBrokenCoefficient / CaptureMaterialCoefficient: multipliers on crafting-material drops
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative (server MUST apply these coefficients when computing EXP/gold/material/drop rewards; core reward-scaling config)

costs: RewardId list = reward package(s) granted at this rank

XML reader for a currency-definition config record. Defines each in-game currency: its CurrencyID, the player-attribute it maps to (AttrID), display Name/Icon/Tips, and an SPId. This is the authoritative currency registry.
formulas: CurrencyID=+0x10, AttrID=+0x14, Name(string via CPet::SetName)=+0x18(str obj), Icon(string via getter vtable+0x24)=+0x1c, Tips(string)=+? , SPId=+0x38
AttrID at +0x14 links a currency to the player-stat/attribute slot that holds its balance
costs: defines the set of currencies and their balance attribute mapping (AttrID) — foundational for all currency mutation validation
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative (server currency registry; every currency add/remove must resolve through CurrencyID->AttrID defined here)
functions.notes: Name and Tips are wide-string fields set via the shared CPet::SetName string setter; Icon set via string getter at param_1+0x1c.
